title: Mumbai to get India’s first city-wide master pedestrian network plan: BMC tells Supreme Court
description: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has informed the Supreme Court that it is preparing India’s first city-wide master pedestrian network plan for Mumbai to create a continuous, connected and universally accessible pedestrian network across the city.In an affidavit filed before the Court, the BMC said the proposed plan would be prepared using its 3D city model integrated with Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping, satellite imagery, LiDAR surveys, drone mapping, development plan d
